text:
elaine-support: urgent — AcmeCorp seeing sustained 429s and high p50/p95 latency during a traffic spike at 10:13 UTC. Dedicated pool did not scale quickly; customers describe ~3m of errors. sample request ids: req_abc123, req_def456. attaching repro notes

marie-cs: customer on reserved/dedicated plan (tenant acme-prod-23). They reported retries didn't help. opened ticket #7891 and flagged SE.

elaine-support: repro I ran (staging):
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\  -d '{"model":"rwd-llm-3b","input":"hello"}'
```
Requests queued, then started returning 429s after ~40s.

ravi-eng-platform: can you paste the provision/attach logs (controller events, imagepull, IAM)? tenant_id=acme-prod-23?

ops-bot: AUTO: provisioner detected repeated probe failures for tenant=acme-prod-23 at 2026-03-15T10:13:07Z, backoff=120s, reason="authz failed", attempts=3.

jon-oncall: saw a pattern like this before — combination of probe suppression + min_replicas floor + slow imagePull/IAM rotation => scaleup stalls. Quick mitigation: bump min_replicas so warm pool exists, or enable short-term burst reservation.

elaine-support: customer ok with temporary change. applying bump: `rcu set-min --tenant acme-prod-23 --min 2`

ops-bot: CONF: min_replicas updated -> 2 for acme-prod-23 by elaine-support at 2026-03-15T10:17:22Z.

emily-sre: grabbing node/kube events now — I see pods scheduled but attach handshake timed out: "attach failed: unauthorized" on node gpu-12 and a concurrent registry pull backoff on node gpu-09. IAM rotation happened ~10:12:50Z (right before spike). Looks like preflight/authz failures prevented probes from succeeding, so autoscaler never observed healthy replicas to count toward demand.

ravi-eng-platform: runtime logs (snippet):
```
[10:13:07] probe: POST /attach -> 401 Unauthorized (token refresh in progress)
[10:13:08] provision: imagePullBackOff: failed to pull registry.redwood/acme-model:v2 - unauthorized
[10:13:30] scale: desired=5, available=1, min_replicas=1 -> no action due to probe suppression
[10:14:10] probe: 429 preflight-rate-limit: preflight quota denied
```

jon-oncall: proposed triage steps: 1) short-term: keep min_replicas=2 and enable warm-burst for acme-prod-23, 2) mid-term: reduce probe interval & add jitter for attach to avoid synchronized auth rotation failures, 3) long-term: change preflight quota reservation to occur earlier in the attach handshake so failed auths don't block counting. I'll open an RFC + issue.

elaine-support: customer reports 429s dropped to near-zero ~2m after min bump; traffic recovered. they're happy for now but want root cause. marking as escalated to eng-runtime and eng-platform. I'll monitor for 60m and update ticket #7891. :white_check_mark:

emily-sre: creating infra ticket for IAM rotation correlation + registry token retrials (INF-3221). we'll dig into why token rotation coincided with heavy probe bursts.

ravi-eng-platform: adding a note — please include kube events, controller logs, and tenant attach traces for the 10:12-10:18 window. I'll follow up with a small patch to add a fallback path that counts provisioned pods even if the final attach probe is delayed by auth refresh.

jon-oncall: logging follow-up actions: create patch PR to add attach jitter + pre-reserve quota, add alert when probe-failures > 5 within 60s, and run chaos test for IAM rotation during scaleups. assigning tasks.

elaine-support: summary for CS: temporary mitigation applied (min_replicas=2). customer recovered. escalated to eng-runtime/eng-platform for root cause and durable fix. next update in ticket #7891 in 1h.
